The '''Systech Corporation''' was a company involved in the manufacture of weapons&mdash;such as the [[Systech aural blaster]]&mdash;as well as a wide variety of other types of products&mdash;possibly [[Droid/Legends|droids]]&mdash;during the [[Old Sith Wars]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. [[HK-47]], a [[HK-series assassin droid]], was designed to resemble a Systech Corporation [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] available around the time; later HK-series model continued the trend, and HK-47 himself worked for Systech for a time.

==Behind the scenes==
Although in his initial encounter with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] HK-47 claims to be a Systech model of droid, further investigations aided by a high repair skill will reveal the truth: that the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] did in fact indirectly cause the breakup of this corporation some time before the outbreak of the [[Jedi Civil War]].
